contaminationRegister.reason: Survey values and adjusted 0050 outcomes were both inspected before this preregistration. May be used only for descriptive method diagnostics and falsification, never as OOS/prospective evidence.

commonRules.eligibilityMeaning: First genuine Taiwan trading/event observation after preregistration; if 2026-10-05 is not an eligible session, use the next valid session.

D20-10.firstEligibleParent: First official Cathay monthly Taiwan economic-confidence survey release after freeze
D20-10.conservativeKnownAt: If exact source publication time is not authenticated, first eligible Taiwan session after the dated public release
D20-10.primaryQuestion: Do sentiment LEVEL and CHANGE add incremental context beyond prior Taiwan-market return and volatility? No directional sign is assumed ex ante.
D20-10.minimumRegimeDiversity: at least 2 materially different market regimes
D20-10.promotionMeaning: Prospective evidence exists; not production eligibility

D20-07.firstEligibleParent: First official TWSE/TPEx attention designation with valid parent receipt on/after earliest eligible date
D20-07.conservativeKnownAt: Next eligible session unless exact same-day availability clock is authenticated
D20-07.primaryQuestion: After controlling the variables that trigger designation, does exchange salience add residual changes in attention/liquidity or subsequent price path? No bullish/bearish sign is assumed.

D20-04.cadence: Last eligible Taiwan session of each week
D20-04.primaryQuestion: Does 52-week reference position add residual information beyond direct momentum/breakout/MA-distance/volatility?
D20-04.primarySpecification: Continuous/rank specification; no post-outcome threshold or quintile search

D20-05.cadence: Same frozen weekly parents as D20-04
D20-05.primaryQuestion: Conditional on D20-04 reference position and D03 momentum, does recency of the reference event retain residual information?
D20-05.primarySpecification: Continuous residual test only; same parent dates as D20-04
D20-05.killRule: If recency adds no stable residual information beyond D20-04/D03, prepare merge/narrowing proposal instead of preserving a duplicate factor.

D20-02.cadence: Last eligible Taiwan session of each week
D20-02.firstEligibleParent: First complete TWSE short-side weekly receipt after freeze
D20-02.primaryQuestion: Conditional on price performance and short-side information variables, does gain/loss state explain covering asymmetry and does that state add subsequent-return information?

D20-08.firstEligibleParent: First event after freeze with valid sourcePublishedAt/capturedAt and preregistered surprise semantics
D20-08.rule: Historical rows with unresolved original first-known clocks remain UNKNOWN/excluded.

D20-12.primaryQuestion: Can the behavioral hypothesis discriminate against at least one plausible structural explanation on prospective common-support parents?
D20-12.promotionRule: May reach L4 only from prospective/OOS discriminating evidence, not merely because upstream modules have outcome data.

l4Decision.nextAction: Begin immutable prospective parent capture; do not open an outcome until its parent receipt and preregistered specification are frozen.
